title: Twilio Account SID and Auth Token: token span with companion SID
summary: A Twilio Account SID (AC + 32 hex) with its Auth Token (32 hex characters) in environment assignments, in HTTP Basic form with the token first, with the SID repeated on separate lines, and with only the token present under TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN. Values are synthetic.
rationale: Twilio uses the Account SID as the Basic-auth username and the Auth Token as the password and tells users to keep the Auth Token secure. The token span is the confidential component; the Account SID is a companion (the authtoken page marks accountSid 'Not PII', which says nothing about secrecy). Failure modes: the token dropped when the SID is repeated or far away, and the SID treated as the secret.

expectation.rationale: Flag the Auth Token span. Twilio's security page states 'Keep your AuthToken secure. It provides access to the REST API and to request signatures.'; the requests page states the Auth Token is the Basic-auth password paired with the Account SID. The Account SID span is a companion with no asserted outcome. The 32-hex token form is claimed by the family contract, not by this case.
